title: Missing trust signals above the fold
summary: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, security badge, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
problem: The homepage shows no sign of returns policy, guarantee, security badge, so a first-time visitor has nothing to offset purchase risk.
recommended_change: notes: Surface review counts, the returns window and a guarantee near the primary call to action.
evidence: Measured on the live homepage: no match for returns policy, guarantee, security badge.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift

title: Ambiguous search input labels
summary: Repeated placeholder text without a clear label confuses users about what the search input accepts, hurting conversion.
problem: Repeated placeholder text without a clear label confuses users about what the search input accepts, hurting conversion.
recommended_change: notes: Replace with a single explicit label such as 'Ask a question or search the web' and remove duplicates.
evidence: What do you want to know?What do you want to know?What do you want to know? Ask anything…
analysts_agreeing: Form & Interaction Friction, Navigation & Information Scent
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

title: Weak page metadata
summary: Search and social previews are degraded: page title (absent), meta description, Open Graph tags are missing or outside recommended lengths.
problem: Search and social previews are degraded: page title (absent), meta description, Open Graph tags are missing or outside recommended lengths.
recommended_change: notes: Write a 15-60 char title and 70-160 char description per page; add og:title and og:image for link previews.
evidence: Measured on the homepage: title 0 chars (15-60 recommended); description 0 chars (70-160 recommended); og:title missing, og:image missing.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

problem: Top navigation items lack descriptive labels, making it hard for users to predict where links lead.

evidence: New ⌃I Computer Computer Artifacts Artifacts Customize Customize Projects Projects

title: Lab Largest Contentful Paint of 3.1 s
summary: Measured in a lab load: the page's main content takes this long to appear on a mid-range phone; most visitors have bounced long before.
problem: Measured in a lab load: the page's main content takes this long to appear on a mid-range phone; most visitors have bounced long before.
evidence: Lighthouse (mobile emulation, single synthetic run via DataForSEO): Largest Contentful Paint 3.1 s against a ‘good’ threshold of 2500ms. Lab data, not real-user field data — confirms the defect class, not the field percentile.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 0.5-2.0% relative lift

title: No responsive viewport declared
summary: Without a viewport meta tag, mobile browsers render the desktop layout scaled down, making every tap target too small and severely hurting mobile conversion.
problem: Without a viewport meta tag, mobile browsers render the desktop layout scaled down, making every tap target too small and severely hurting mobile conversion.
evidence: Measured on the mobile render: no <meta name="viewport"> present.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 2.0-8.0% relative lift

problem: The ticker input lacks a visible label or hint, adding friction for users wanting to look up another stock.

title: Controls without accessible names
summary: 12 of 22 buttons expose no text label, so screen readers and voice control cannot address them and the control is unusable.
problem: 12 of 22 buttons expose no text label, so screen readers and voice control cannot address them and the control is unusable.
recommended_change: notes: Give every control a visible text label or an aria-label. WCAG 2.2 AA, success criterion 4.1.2 Name, Role, Value.
evidence: Measured on the live homepage: 12 of 22 <button> elements contain no text content and no aria-label.
opportunity_basis: per 1,000 visitors at an assumed 2.00% baseline conversion rate and a 1.0-5.0% relative lift
